newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish 10-yr bond auction covered 5.15 times - NTMA.
newsitem.headline: Irish 10-yr bond auction covered 5.15 times - NTMA.

text.p: Ireland's National Treasury Management Agency (NTMA) said on Tuesday that a 150 million Irish pound auction of the eight percent bond due 2006 was covered 5.15 times.
The stock, sold to primary dealers in a competitive auction, achieved an average price of 108.24 to give an annual yield of 6.77 percent, the NTMA said.
The highest accepted price was 108.26 for a yield of 6.77 percent and the lowest accepted price was 108.22 to yield 6.78 percent.
Of the bids at the lowest price, 75 percent of each bid was filled, the agency said.
Stock was sold at a price of 108.24 in a non-competitive auction of up to 30 million punts for primary dealers.
